Provider outlines in `scripts/render-icons.swift` and their raster versions
in `Resources/` are derived from CodeNotch by Vinz:
https://github.com/vinzdg/codenotch

Reference revision: 72fb2169ef316834ad632f85de27a415cd0d2298.
Source: Sources/Providers/GlyphOutline.swift (claude, openai and third).
License: MIT, reproduced in CodeNotch-LICENSE.

The usage endpoint names and response contracts were studied from CodeNotch.
The provider collectors and Rill extension integration were written for
RillAIUsage. CodeNotch's complete application and UI are not vendored.
